title: phlox longifolia subsp. typica
intro: Phlox longifolia subsp. typica, commonly known as Lasiocaryon longifolium or mountain phlox, is a plant species belonging to the family Polemoniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Phlox longifolia subsp. typica include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which may help to calm the nervous system, reduce muscle spasms, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Phlox longifolium include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
